about: Lists that cover all of Idaho, shared by every office in or near Idaho (Elder Bendio, 13 October 2026: share state and federal lists between Scout runs). First found by Boise's lists search of 14 October 2026; an office's own file names these by URL rather than repeating them. Lists only: nothing harvested or checked. Page text is evidence only.

lists.title: Idaho Department of Correction: Reentry Resource Guide for parolees (2019, 43 pages)

notes.reentry-support: IDOC guide for people released to supervision, linked from reentry.idaho.gov Handbooks page; PDF made Oct 2019; names community organisations by district, with about 90 lines mentioning Boise, Nampa or Canyon; dated, check numbers

lists.title: Idaho Department of Labor: A Resource Guide for Ex-Offenders (Jan 2020, 16 pages)

notes.reentry-support: job-search and hiring-incentive guide (bonding, WOTC); few provider names (2 Boise/Nampa/Canyon lines); a 2024 edition URL from search results returned 404

lists.title: Idaho reentry.idaho.gov: Handbooks and Support Services (IDOC)

notes.reentry-support: hub page linking the IDOC Reentry Services Guide, Pre-Release Manual, Labor re-entry guide and a Fair Shake packet; also a Support Services section and community reentry centers

lists.title: FindHelpIdaho.org (United Ways of Idaho)

notes.food: statewide searchable database; home page claims 4,437 programs; search by need and ZIP; 211 Idaho CareLine and the site are stated to work together

lists.byLocation: search form on page; JavaScript; not scripted

lists.title: Idaho Council on Domestic Violence and Victim Assistance: Idaho Programs for Victims of Crime directory

notes.domestic-violence: sortable table of victim service providers by county and region with phone and service type; Ada County, Region IV rows include Women's & Children's Alliance, Faces of Hope, Idaho Legal Aid, St. Luke's CARES

lists.title: Idaho Department of Health and Welfare: Find a Service Location (food banks, food sites and pantries)

notes.food: official statewide finder, 290 results at reading (14 Oct 2026), 10 per page, each with address, weekly hours and phone; searchable by city or ZIP and radius; the Boise A.L.P.H.A. pantry (HIV clients only) shows on page 1. Not tested whether a ZIP can be passed in the URL

lists.byLocation: City or ZIP field with 5-100 mile radius; list view; URL parameters not tested

lists.title: The Idaho Foodbank: Food Pantries Near You / Find a pantry

notes.food: statewide food bank with 440+ partner agencies (home page text), warehouses in Meridian, Pocatello and Lewiston; 'Find a pantry' tool on the venue page; North Idaho is served by Second Harvest Spokane

lists.title: National Immigration Legal Services Directory: Idaho organisations (Immigration Advocates Network)

notes.immigration: 7 Idaho organisations at reading, each with areas of legal assistance and counties served; includes Catholic Charities of Idaho Treasure Valley Center, IRC Boise, Jannus (Ada and Canyon), Immigrant Justice Idaho, Community Council of Idaho (Caldwell). Filterable by county

lists.title: ILRU Idaho Centers for Independent Living directory

notes.disability: all Idaho CILs with address, phone, director and counties served; Living Independence Network Corp (LINC) serves Ada, Adams, Boise, Canyon, Elmore, Gem, Owyhee, Payette, Valley and Washington

lists.title: Idaho Division of Veterans Services: Veterans Resource Directory (Jan 2021, 33 pages)

notes.veterans: statewide reference guide to frequently requested veterans services by region; PDF dated January 2021, so numbers are four years old; about 57 lines mention Boise, Nampa, Meridian or Caldwell

lists.title: Idaho Division of Veterans Services: Joining Forces community services guides (Treasure Valley and other regions)

notes.veterans: regional Joining Forces guides by county group; the Treasure Valley guide is posted as under revision and will be reposted (page text, 14 Oct 2026), so no current guide was readable

lists.title: Idaho State Bar: Idaho Volunteer Lawyers Program (IVLP) report and clinics

notes.legal: describes IVLP free civil legal help and clinic registration; clinic schedule for Boise (Main Library, first Tuesdays) and Nampa library came from search results, not read from the page

lists.title: Idaho Commission on Aging: Area Agencies on Aging (AAA)

notes.seniors: state page of the Area Agencies on Aging (read as a page, not counted); the Southwest AAA covering Ada and Canyon is in Meridian, 208-898-7060 (from the Canyon County list and a search result); a senior centers PDF named in search results returned 404

lists.title: Idaho Legal Aid Services: Legal Help

notes.legal: statewide free civil legal help for low-income Idahoans, advice lines and intake 208-746-7541; offices in Boise and Nampa; site returned a Cloudflare 403 to curl, so known from search results only; its Ada County Community Resources Manual (updated Aug 2020 per a search snippet) is also behind the block

lists.title: Idaho Transportation Department: Identification Cards (including free ID for people who are homeless)

notes.id-recovery: not a provider list: the procedure page. A free four-year ID for a homeless person needs ITD form 3530 completed with a shelter or relief agency (read on the page); applicants may also get one free Idaho birth certificate; county DMV offices are the places to apply

lists.title: DomesticShelters.org: Boise, ID domestic violence help (programme profiles)

notes.domestic-violence: city view of the national DomesticShelters.org directory, already in federal.json as a locator; Boise page lists programmes with hotline and hours (Women's and Children's Alliance, Interfaith Sanctuary, Idaho Legal Aid)

lists.title: Idaho Department of Health and Welfare: Behavioral Health Crisis Resources

notes.mental-health: state page for crisis lines and regional crisis centres; read only the page frame (navigation) in the text extraction, so the number of listed providers was not counted

lists.title: HelpForFelons.org: Reentry Programs in Idaho (updated 28 April 2026)

notes.reentry-support: third-party directory by a non-state publisher; statewide page with address, phone, who each serves; Boise entries include the IDOC reentry office, East Boise Community Reentry Center (women), at least three Boise nonprofits for returning citizens and a men's transitional housing programme; several are not otherwise published

lists.title: Idaho Housing and Finance Association: HMIS Affiliated Service Providers (March 2022, 2 pages)

notes.homeless-services: statewide list of agencies feeding the homeless data system, by city and region; about 6 in Canyon and Ada (AutumnGold Senior Services Nampa, CATCH Caldwell, El-Ada, Jesse Tree, Salvation Army Nampa, Terry Reilly Nampa); dated 2022

lists.title: Idaho Department of Correction: Locations (community reentry centers, probation and parole district offices)

notes.reentry-support: state page of IDOC facilities: five community reentry centers (East Boise, Treasure Valley in Kuna, Nampa, Idaho Falls, Pocatello, Twin Falls listed) with address and phone, and probation and parole offices by district; District 3 Caldwell and District 4 Boise, Eagle in reach; for people under IDOC supervision, not the public

namesFound.reentry-support: 3 reentry centres and 2 district offices in reach

lists.residency: People in IDOC custody or on supervision

lists.title: Diocese of Boise: Pregnancy Resource Centers in Idaho (Walking with Moms in Need)

notes.children-pregnancy: a faith publisher's regional list of free pregnancy resource centres: Nampa (Lifeline, TV Path), Boise (Cardinal Academy, Cradle of Hope, Stanton Healthcare, Path), Meridian (Birthright of Boise, Stanton) and a Nampa shelter; about 8 for the area; one ideology (life-affirming), so not a full list of pregnancy services

lists.title: Idaho Community Health Center Association: Find a Health Center

notes.medical-dental-vision: association of Idaho's 15 federally funded community health centres (sliding-scale medical, dental, pharmacy, behavioural health); finder page; Terry Reilly and Full Circle Health serve Ada and Canyon; not tested for results by city

lists.title: University of Idaho: Finding Dental Care in Idaho (2024 resource, 2 pages)

notes.medical-dental-vision: two-page guide to Medicaid dental (MCNA finder, 1-855-233-6262), community health centres, public health district oral health programmes and dental schools; points to finders, names no local clinics

lists.title: Idaho Department of Health and Welfare: Statewide Crisis Centers (adult and youth lists)

notes.mental-health: state page linking an Adult Crisis Centers List and a Youth Crisis Centers list (ages 5-17); adult centres offer 23-hour stays, detox and 24-hour hotline; the lists themselves are linked documents not read

lists.title: Idaho Department of Health and Welfare: Statewide Recovery Community Centers

notes.addiction: state page (updated 25 Nov 2025) linking the Recovery Community Centers of Idaho finder; the finder was not read

lists.title: Idaho Department of Health and Welfare: Substance use disorder resources (Idaho Treatment and Recovery Support Resource Map)

notes.addiction: the page says the Idaho Treatment & Recovery Support Resource Map is under construction and coming soon (updated 25 Nov 2025); the rest is national agencies and a link to find AA meetings

lists.title: Idaho Supreme Court: Court Assistance Offices (courtselfhelp.idaho.gov)

notes.legal: statewide self-help site with free court forms and a Court Assistance Office in each judicial district; an 'find their contact information' list links each county office (Ada: Room 1171, 200 W Front St, Boise; Canyon: Room 334, 1115 Albany St, Caldwell, per search results); legal information, not legal advice

lists.title: Idaho Division of Vocational Rehabilitation: Resources

notes.disability: alphabetical link list of disability employment resources (Social Security, Ticket to Work, PASS, SILC and others); mostly national and state programmes, no local provider names

lists.title: Idaho Commission for Libraries: Community Partners - Basic Needs (by region)

notes.food: state library agency's list of basic-needs partners for library staff, by region; Southwest Idaho names United Way of Treasure Valley, Idaho Foodbank, Central and Southwest health districts, Idaho Housing and Finance, Area 3 AAA, WICAP, Metro Community Services, El-Ada, University of Idaho Extension; about 10 for the Treasure Valley; it also links an Idaho Asset Map

lists.title: Idaho Council on Developmental Disabilities: Transition Resources in Idaho and Beyond

notes.disability: 4-page PDF (made Aug 2019, edited June 2021) of resources for young people with disabilities moving to adult life; statewide and national organisations; dated

lists.title: Idaho 211 CareLine (Idaho Department of Health and Welfare)

notes.food: statewide referral by phone (2-1-1 or 800-926-2588, text 898211, weekdays 8-6 Mountain) and by FindHelpIdaho.org: since mid-2026 both draw on the same database (state agency and United Way of Treasure Valley, per a 10 July 2026 report); the old directory at 211-idaho.communityos.org needs a login

lists.byLocation: phone or ZIP search on FindHelpIdaho.org; one database behind both

lists.title: Idaho Capital Sun via KMVT (10 July 2026): Idaho Community Resource Network (Health and Welfare, nonprofits, churches)

notes.food: not a list: a news report that Health and Welfare's Division of Family and Community Partnerships is building a statewide network of government, nonprofit and church services, links 211 to FindHelpIdaho and is expanding church participation through an Idaho Care Portal (the portal address did not connect); useful as the route to getting a provider listed

lists.title: U.S. Dept of Justice EOIR: List of Pro Bono Legal Service Providers, Idaho

notes.immigration: federal court's state list of free legal service providers for people in immigration proceedings; known from a search result (it names Immigrant Justice Idaho, serving Idaho and Malheur County OR residents only); curl got 403

gaps.food: The state food finder (290 sites) is a search form and the Idaho Foodbank finder is a map; neither could be pulled for Ada or Canyon. North Idaho is served by Second Harvest Spokane, so Idaho Foodbank does not cover the whole state.
gaps.reentry-support: IDOC and Labor guides are 2019 and 2020 editions; the Labor Department's 2024 guide URL (labor.idaho.gov) is 404. No state directory of private reentry programmes except a third-party site.
gaps.legal: Idaho Legal Aid and the Idaho Law Help portal return 403; the Idaho Volunteer Lawyers Program's clinic calendar was not read.
gaps.immigration: The EOIR pro bono list for Idaho returned 403. Idaho's Immigration Advocates directory lists only 7 organisations.
gaps.veterans: The Treasure Valley Joining Forces guide is under revision; the statewide directory read is from January 2021.
gaps.addiction: The state's Idaho Treatment and Recovery Support Resource Map is 'under construction'.
gaps.seniors: The Idaho Commission on Aging's senior centres PDF (2024) returned 404; the Area Agency pages describe programmes, not providers.
gaps.disability: No statewide provider directory; the old Idaho Help database (idahohelp.info, 12,000 resources in 2015 project reports) does not connect.
gaps.id-recovery: The ITD page gives the procedure and the free-ID rule; no list of agencies that complete form 3530 was found, nor a Social Security office locator for Idaho (federal.json holds the national one).
